meta.description: Senior full-stack engineer and technical lead with 20+ years designing and shipping enterprise systems in Java, Spring Boot, Oracle, React and Angular.

hero.name: Agustín Estévez
hero.headline: I design and build the systems that keep field teams, APIs and databases in sync — and keep them running in production for years.

facts.label: field inspections a day on a system I designed

about.title: About
body: I started as a developer in 2006 and grew into business analysis, data modeling, solution design and technical leadership — without ever stepping away from the code.

Most of my work lives where systems meet: Android devices syncing with web platforms, batch processes feeding commercial systems, legacy apps migrated to modern stacks. I care about clear data models, tested code and solutions that are still easy to change ten years later.
Lately I build with AI-assisted engineering: custom Claude Code agents for QA, security and code review, backed by a solid testing practice with JUnit, Mockito and Vitest.

caseStudy.title: Mobile Customer Engagement Management (GCM)

problem.label: The problem
problem.text: Two electric distribution companies in the Dominican Republic contracted customers and inspected properties on paper. Getting a new customer into the billing cycle could take months.

role.label: My role
role.text: Project leader and solution architect, from business requirements to production. I defined the scope with stakeholders, designed the data model and integrations, and led a team of up to 7 engineers.

solution.label: The solution
solution.text: A platform that digitized contracting and field inspections: Android devices sync over REST with a Spring web application, and Oracle PL/SQL batch processes validate every record against business rules before it updates the Commercial Management System (SGC).

caseStudy.impact: Customer onboarding went from months to days — often the same day.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Recent full-stack work, built end to end and fully tested.

items.name: FacturasApp
items.description: An invoicing application I built by directing Claude Code: I wrote the architecture rules, designed custom agents for QA, security hardening and Angular code review, and orchestrated them across the project.
highlights: 95-test backend suite: unit, web layer, repository and integration
JWT in HttpOnly cookies, CSRF protection, per-IP rate limiting and security headers
Custom MCP server in TypeScript, plus Supabase and Playwright integrations

image.alt: FacturasApp invoice list with status filters, search and pagination

items.name: Real-Time Chat
items.description: A real-time chat I wrote by hand to sharpen my testing and frontend practice: presence, typing indicators and persisted history.
highlights: Spring Boot 4 backend with WebSocket/STOMP messaging and JPA persistence
React 19 + TypeScript frontend with connection, messaging and typing logic in custom hooks
Layered tests: MockMvc, @DataJpaTest, Vitest and React Testing Library with fake timers

items.name: This portfolio
items.description: Built with Next.js and React, statically exported for SEO, with English and Spanish versions and motion that respects reduced-motion settings.
highlights: Static export with per-language metadata, hreflang and structured data
Server components by default; client code only where there is motion
Lighthouse 95+ across performance, accessibility and SEO
